changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Create append-only, action-scoped idempotency receipts for canonical implementation writes.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE modeling_model_implementation_command_receipt ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_implementation_command_receipt_payload CHECK ( action IN ('SAVE', 'IMPORT', 'OWNERSHIP_CONVERT', 'CLAIM') AND btrim(tenant_id) <> '' AND tenant_id = btrim(tenant_id) AND btrim(idempotency_key) <> '' AND idempotency_key = btrim(idempotency_key) AND payload_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND model_revision > 0 AND model_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ownership IN ('DESIGNER_GENERATED', 'DBT_MANAGED') AND btrim(project_key) <> '' AND project_key = btrim(project_key) AND btrim(dbt_unique_id) <> '' AND dbt_unique_id = btrim(dbt_unique_id) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND implementation_revision > 0 AND implementation_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND input_mode IN ('PHYSICAL_ASSET', 'UPSTREAM_MODEL', 'GENERATED') AND jsonb_typeof(inputs_json) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(field_mappings_json) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(settings_json) = 'object' AND octet_length(inputs_json::text) <= 1048576 AND octet_length(field_mappings_json::text) <= 1048576 AND octet_length(settings_json::text) <= 1048576 AND materialization IN ('table', 'view', 'incremental') AND btrim(created_by) <> '' AND created_by = btrim(created_by) );

CREATE TRIGGER trg_model_implementation_command_receipt_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON modeling_model_implementation_command_receipt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION modeling_reject_implementation_command_receipt_mutation();

CREATE TRIGGER trg_model_implementation_command_receipt_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON modeling_model_implementation_command_receipt FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION modeling_reject_implementation_command_receipt_mutation();
